name: URY admin master list (Table)
describe: Schema-driven master list: the Table master from data/schemas/table.json inside the admin shell. Full-bleed toolbar (view toggle, search, Edit Layout, Add Table), a DataTable of tables with shape and status badges, and the SideDrawer form (512px card over a blurred scrim) in the open variants.

Use for any admin master doctype list that edits through a drawer (Table, Room, Menu). Column and field labels are the schema titles; the toolbar search follows the master-list pattern, the source TablePage itself has no search box.
